title: I've Been Doing This for Nine Years
gist_ar: مقابلة في بودكاست مع راجل بيصلّح عجل: بدأ بالغلط وبقى بيحب التعليم أكتر من التصليح.

before_listening.en: A podcast interview about somebody's work and hobby. Listen for HOW the business started.
before_listening.ar: مقابلة بودكاست عن شغل وهواية واحد. ركّز على الشغل ده بدأ إزاي.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: You have been repairing bicycles in the same shop for nine years. How did it start?

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: By accident. I had been working in an office for six years, and I hated it. I had been fixing my own bike since I was a boy, and one evening a neighbour asked me to look at hers. Then her brother came. Then his friends. I have been doing it ever since. For the first two years I was still in the office, so I was repairing bikes until midnight and going to work tired. I have been teaching a class on Saturdays for about eighteen months now, and that is the part I enjoy most. People arrive thinking a bicycle is complicated. It is not. It has been more or less the same machine for a hundred years, and it wants to be understood, not respected.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: And the office? Do you ever miss it?

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: I have not thought about the office for years. That is the answer.
